target_host.description: The target hostname or IP address to send packets to.

protocol_mode.description: Protocol mode: tcp (default, no flag), rawip (-0), icmp (-1), udp (-2), scan (-8).

packet_count.description: Number of packets to send. 0 means unlimited.

interval.description: Wait time between packets. Suffix 'u' indicates microseconds.

spoofed_ip.description: Fake source IP address for spoofing.

ttl.description: Time To Live value for IP packets.

tcp_flags.description: Comma-separated TCP flags to set (SYN, ACK, FIN, RST, PSH, URG, XMAS, YMAS).

data_size.description: Size of the data payload in bytes.

data_file.description: Filename to read data from for packet payload.

signature.description: Signature string to embed in packet data.

verbosity.description: Output level: none, verbose, or debug.

icmp_type.description: ICMP type code (e.g., 8 for Echo Request).

raw_ip_proto.description: IP protocol number for raw IP mode (e.g., 6 for TCP, 1 for ICMP).

scan_port_groups.description: Port groups to scan in scan mode (e.g., '1-1000,80,known').

keep_source_port.description: Keep source port constant instead of incrementing.

safe_mode.description: Enable safe protocol for file transfers.

numeric_only.description: Disable DNS lookups for numeric output.

dont_fragment.description: Set the Don't Fragment (DF) IP flag.
